text: Hello everyone, welcome back.Today we are going to deal with the writing section.In this period, you will learn about the covering letter in terms of layout, content and language.You are also expected to write a covering letter to apply for an internship position as a summer camp counselor, using the correct layout and proper language.Before class, please get your textbooks and worksheets ready.Have you ever applied for some kind of club, your school society or some volunteering work?How did you apply for it?You might apply for it by email, or you might apply for it on the spot, or you could apply for it by sending a covering letter.What is a covering letter?It's a letter you send with your CV or resume as part of a job application.What is the purpose of a covering letter?It gives more information about your career and experience that can't be included in the CV.Students, please read the advertisement and answer the following questions.You will have 30 seconds for that.Now, let's check the answers.Mary Frank will read your letter.The job requires the applicant to be hardworking, having excellent IT skills and being organized and efficient.If you were to apply for this position, which aspects would you include in the letter?Maybe you will write about your past work experience.You might list your reasons for application.You might show your qualifications.That's good.Now, I would like you to open your textbook and turn to page 16.Please read the sample letter and find out which aspects from exercise one are mentioned.We will see whether we have guessed correctly.Also, what's the layout of the letter?You will have one minute for that.Please read the sample letter.Well, have you finished?The sample letter mentioned all aspects except questions about the pay.The layout of the letter looks familiar, right?It includes a salutation, a body and a closing, just like some letter writings you learned in senior one.But, did you notice some features of a current letter?For example, RE.What does it mean?It means in reference to.This is to tell the receiver what the letter is about.Besides, the receiver will be able to tell you what the letter is about.Besides, when writing a covering letter, you need to tell the receiver what documents you are attaching.So, you must write a sentence like, please find my CV enclosed.Then, let's focus on the main part of the covering letter.Would you please read the body part again and figure out what is included?It's easy to find that the body part of the letter includes the writing purpose, that is why you are writing and where you saw the job advertisement, the reasons for your interest in the position, the information about your qualifications and experience, and also the available time.Students, now let's read these two paragraphs about qualifications and experience more carefully.This time, please focus on the content and the language.Read and complete the table.How is your work?As for the qualifications, the writer achieved excellent grades in the exams and received a computer certificate.As for job experience, he worked as a library assistant and a service advisor.The writer describes his experience and qualifications specifically.And how did he achieve the effect?He uses specific facts, dates and numbers.For example, received a computer certificate in May last year, for the last two years, right?The writer gives specific examples of how the experience and skills match the employer's requirements.For example, gained some useful experience in sorting books, have also developed an online catalog, and assisted with filing and scanning documents.What's more, he uses a variety of action verbs.You can have a look at those circled verbs.What language does the writer use to connect ideas?Well, he uses some conjunctive adverbs like also, furthermore.He uses phrases like, as you can see, in this row, as part of my job experience.Besides, he uses conjunction like anything else.Students, these are some more conjunctive adverbs and conjunctions you can use in your writing.Now, everybody, it's your turn to write a covering letter to apply for a summer camp counselor.Let's get started.Read the advertisement first, and think about the qualifications and experiences you have concerning this position.You will have one minute to think about it.Well, to be a summer camp counselor, you need to show your motivation for working with kids, highlight the activities, sports, and hobbies you are passionate about, and explain why you would like to be a counselor at camp.Let's hear some students' ideas.So I believe I'm quite competent for your advertised position.Oh, the boy focuses on arts and music talents.Wow, the girl was experienced in working with children.Great.Now, you will have to write a cover letter to the counselor.You may refer to the guide given on the screen.詞曲 李宗盛詞曲 李宗盛詞曲 李宗盛詞曲 李宗盛詞曲 李宗盛詞曲 李宗盛詞曲 李宗盛詞曲 李宗盛詞曲 李宗盛詞曲 李宗盛詞曲 李宗盛詞曲 李宗盛詞曲 above》的文章,這文章是在網上發佈的。請找我的CV在網上搜尋。我是一位學生,從上海的體驗學校,只有孩子比小孩還年輕。我的年齡代表著我對運動和音樂有相似的品味。當我把孩子們視為同樣的人,我會忍受失誤,並願意幫助。我是一位11歲的姐姐,很多時候我都會舉辦派對,開玩笑,和她的同學一起玩遊戲。除此之外,我經常幫助媽媽煮菜和洗碗,獲得食物準備的經驗。去年夏天,我在我鄰居中協助,教導年輕人的音樂、藝術和運動。不僅是我嘗試過普通的方法,我還在不同的範疇中探索。在某個活動中,學生聽到傳統的鋼琴,例如Mozart和Beethoven,並表達了情緒,包括塗鴉和塗筆。在另一個活動中,學生使用鋼琴,把鋼琴畫下來,並讓工作人員演繹。無論他們成功或失敗,每個孩子都能感受到創意,並帶來大笑。這經驗教導了我如何處理抗爭,增強學習和鼓勵孩子的興趣。我馬上就要開始面試了。我期待成為年輕人的美麗中秋夜夢想者。你真心的,Angela。謝謝你分享,Angela。這是一封很精緻的文章,包含了詳細的資訊關於工作要求。如果我是Alice Brooke,我肯定會為你提供這個職位。在未來的互動活動中,請與你的合作伙伴交換你的書籍,並作出關於職位的評論。今天的試驗,請將你的書籍用作評論。今天就到此為止,謝謝觀看,再見。
